title: TTP Gunmen Kill 6 FC Personnel in Musa Dara Attack — Trigger for Strike Pause's End
detail: TTP-linked militants attacked a Frontier Corps post in the Musa Dara area (Hasan Khel, near Peshawar) on June 9, 2026, killing six FC personnel. TTP-affiliated media subsequently circulated images of abducted paramilitary personnel. Pakistani officials cited the attack as the immediate trigger for the resumption of Operation Ghazab lil-Haq cross-border strikes the following day (June 10), ending a 35-day pause in Pakistani strikes into Afghan territory that had held since the May 5 Dangam (Kunar) strike.

title: Taliban Forces Fire on Herat Dress-Code Protest — 11-Year-Old Boy Killed
detail: Following the detention of at least 30 women in Herat for alleged noncompliance with Taliban dress-code enforcement, residents of a predominantly Hazara neighborhood staged a protest chanting 'Work, Education, and Freedom.' Taliban security forces beat and pushed protesters before opening fire as the crowd dispersed, killing an 11-year-old boy and wounding at least three others; house-to-house searches followed. Human Rights Watch researcher Fereshta Abbasi said the Taliban 'fear any dissent and so are escalating their repression of free expression.'

sources.name: Human Rights Watch — Afghanistan: Taliban Use Excessive Force Against Protesters
